title: Seville, March 2025
summary: Four-night trip built around food, architecture and evening walks. Seville was excellent in mild weather but would be less appealing in high heat.
whatWorked: Santa Cruz and Triana were memorable walking areas.
Evenings were the best time for wandering, plazas and tapas.
The city rewarded a relaxed pace with long breaks between major sights.
Warm but not hot weather made outdoor meals and walks enjoyable.
whatDidNotWork: Midday sun was tiring even outside peak summer.
Some major sights needed timed planning.
The trip would have been much weaker with temperatures above 30C.
weatherNotes: Ideal daytime range was about 20-26C with cooler evenings. Heat risk should be a major factor for later spring, summer or early autumn trips.
futureRecommendation: Seville is a very strong fit in spring or late autumn when temperatures are mild. Avoid periods with high heat, limited shade or a schedule that requires walking long distances at midday.
